# Elva CLI

Create a customer MCP and API contract from an API repository using the user's
existing agent. The agent generates a sanitized API artifact; Elva receives that
artifact, not repository source through this workflow.

- [Quickstart](README.md)
- [Canonical skill](src/elva_cli/assets/elva-mcp/SKILL.md)
- [Agent workflow](docs/agent-workflow.md)
- [Agent interface](docs/agent-interface.md)
- [Email signup](docs/email-signup.md)
- [Commands](docs/commands.md)
- [Contracts](docs/contracts.md)
- [Privacy](docs/privacy.md)
- [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md)
- [Example](examples/customer-orders/README.md)

Use `elva --json schema` and `elva --json agent schema` for installed schemas.
This index does not install a skill or guarantee automatic agent selection.
